captions.detailed: A desktop box fan featuring a light grey square main housing mounted on a low-profile U-shaped tilt stand. A black speed control knob is positioned on the upper right side of the housing. The front and back of the housing feature protective grilles, through which the internal propeller is visible. The housing can tilt forward and backward on its side hinge joints, while the internal propeller and the side control knob are designed for continuous rotational movement.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a desktop box fan with a square housing, front and rear grilles, an internal propeller, and a side control knob. The housing should be mounted on a U-shaped support stand, allowing it to tilt on a horizontal axis, while the propeller and knob should be modeled for continuous rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the fan by first creating the base stand using box sweeps or rectangular extrusions to form a low U-shape frame. Build the main square housing using a hollowed-out box primitive with circular cutouts on the front and back faces, adding thin arrayed slats or perforated plates for the grilles. Model the internal propeller with a central cylinder hub and helical or angled blade extrusions, and create the side knob using a fluted cylinder. Establish revolute joints for the housing tilt relative to the stand, and continuous joints for the propeller and the speed knob.
